title: —What kind of a name is that?
html_source:
Compare this with what Buck Mulligan says in the first chapter of Ulysses,

—The mockery of it! he said gaily. Your absurd name, an ancient Greek!

Stephen might answer ‘Greek’ or ‘mythological’ or ‘fictional’ or ‘bestowed upon me by my Creator’.

If James Joyce was asked what kind of name is ‘Joyce’ he could cite his Irish family tree, or the supposed etymology from ‘joy’.
